cash_event_audit.factual_mechanism: Strategy started 2020-01-01 with 0 positions (100% cash); 20-EMA benchmark regime gate was BEARISH (0) on 2020-01-31, 2020-02-28, and 2020-03-31, suppressing all equity entries throughout the crash. No liquidation or sell transactions occurred in the window; first buys executed on 2020-05-04.
